text:
ana: starting quiet-window deploy for inference-orchestrator v5.0. high level: staged featureflag llm_route_v5 with tiny canary then gradual tilt. Plan: 0 -> 0.01 (canary 3 hosts) -> 0.08 -> 0.35 -> 1.0 over ~30m. enterprise and compliance cohorts pinned to model=v4.4 until final pass. release notes: https://internal.redwood/releases/2026-03-26/orchestrator-v5.0

kai: ack. please add deploybot holdpoint after 0.08. gates: error_rate > 1.2% OR p95 latency +22% OR quality-drop > 1.0% -> pause and page #eng-oncall. also watch fallback-rate and cache-hit delta. soft-session-drain 6m for canary hosts. :thumbsup:

deploybot: automated: created canary set Z (3 hosts). llm_route_v5 -> 0.01. telemetry stream /ops/telemetry/deploy/7955555555 live. holdpoint scheduled at step 3.

ana: (typo earlier) quick note: will be sampling 10% of responses for the regression harness regset_small. quality gate: bleu_delta <= 0.9% and exact_match_loss <= 1.1%

kai: adding rollback shortcut to thread for ops clipboard:
```
# revert flag and drain canary Z quickly
curl -X PATCH -H 'Authorization: Bearer $DEPLOY_TOKEN' https://api.redwood/flags/llm_route_v5 -d '{"value":0}'
deploybot action: drain --group canaryZ --grace 360
```

ops: note added to runbook: enterprise routing-pin applied to cohort enterprise@redwood until final_promote. support playbook updated with pinned-version info.

deploybot: canary Z metrics @ +5m: error_rate=0.4% p95=200ms (+9%) token_cost=+2% fallback_rate=0.3% regset_small delta=+0.1% -> within gates. proceeding to 0.08 in 6m.

ana: excellent. infra - please warm +10% GPU headroom at +12m.

ops: autoscale +10% scheduled.

deploybot: promoting to 0.08. holdpoint active. telemetry snapshot saved: /ops/telemetry/deploy/7955555555/snap-1

kai: reading telemetry: p50 ok, p95 +11%, error_rate stable. quality shows a tiny accuracy uptick for long-context prompts. proceeding unless any gate trips.

deploybot: holdpoint check: gates clear. scheduled next tilt to 0.35 in 8m. scheduled final promote to 1.0 at 00:30 UTC unless holdpoint trips.

ana: reminder - if fallback-rate spikes > 2% we abort and rollback; if p95 crosses threshold we pause and investigate. support: prepping brief to send to committed customers about pinning and rollback plan.

support: prepping blurb + quick rollback steps for Zendesk. will post final release note to #release-notes after green.

kai: if anything noisy appears I'll flip fast-drain and pin routing back to v4.4 for enterprise. otherwise monitoring closely. :eyes:
